info.title: defuscator — static JavaScript deobfuscation and risk triage
info.description: Static JavaScript deobfuscation and risk triage from the command line. Unpacks Dean Edwards P.A.C.K.E.R., obfuscator.io string arrays, hex/unicode escapes and source maps, then reports a risk score, IOCs and SARIF — without ever executing the analyzed code. Exit code reflects risk so it can gate CI.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit the full analysis as JSON (for pipelines).

options.name: --sarif
options.description: Emit SARIF 2.1.0 (GitHub code scanning / SOC pipelines).

options.name: --sourcemap
options.description: Recover original sources from an inline source map.

options.name: --obfuscate
options.description: Obfuscate the input instead of analyzing it (static, no eval).

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
Exit code: 0 = low/none, 1 = medium risk, 2 = high risk (>=68). Code is never executed.
